title: safcodental.com
description: Status: Leaked | Revenue: $47M | Safco Dental Supply LLC specializes in providing a wide range of dental supplies, products, and equipment, including restorative and cosmetic dentistry supplies, endodontics, orthodontics, and infection control products. They cater to dental professionals by offering over 20,000 products, expert support, and efficient shopping solutions. The company also provides comprehensive dental equipment services and customized financing solutions to support dental practices. With a focus on reliability and safety, Safco aims to enhance patient care and streamline operations for dental professionals.
